content.stem: [反洗钱和反恐怖融资合规标准]根据OFAC对“美国人”和特定非美国人交易的管辖规则,以下哪两项表述准确？(选择两项.)

options.A: 在美国设有分支机构的外国法人的总部无需遵守美国海外资产控制办公室(OFAC)的规定.
options.B: 前往美国短期度假的外国个人有义务遵守美国海外资产控制办公室(OFAC)的规定.
options.C: 美国公民无论身处世界何地,都必须遵守美国海外资产控制办公室(OFAC)的规定.
options.D: 任何外国公司只要与任何受制裁国家进行交易,就必然受到OFAC处罚.
options.E: 一家在美国注册成立但在外国正式注册的公司同样受OFAC管辖

content.stem_en: Under OFAC rules governing U.S. persons and specified transactions by non-U.S. persons, which two statements are accurate? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: The head office of a foreign legal entity that has a branch in the U.S. does not need to comply with OFAC rules.
options_en.B: A foreign individual visiting the U.S. for a short vacation is obligated to follow OFAC rules.
options_en.C: U.S. nationals must comply with OFAC rules, regardless of where they are located in the world.
options_en.D: Any foreign corporation is automatically penalized merely for conducting any transaction with any sanctioned country.
options_en.E: A company incorporated in the U.S. but formally registered in a foreign country is also subject to OFAC jurisdiction.
